title: Operation stage transition tower transport
statement: For E ≤ L ≤ M and W at stage E, the defining operation-stage transition isomorphisms transport the recorded stage-system associator to the intrinsic rational scalar associator: T_k(q_EL) followed by q_LM at the transition of W and the intrinsic associator equals the stage associator followed by q_EM.

source.place: Transport of the stage-system uniqueness equations through eqToIso.

proof.text: The declaration records the corresponding finite scalar composition or stage-system transport calculation and is left for a subsequent proof worker.

proof_origin.place: Transport of the stage-system uniqueness equations through eqToIso.

from.place: Decomposition of the finite omega tower proof.

lean.statement:
theorem operationStageTransitionIso_tower
    {E L M : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M)
    (W : Stage l Ω X E) :
    ((stageSystem l Ω X).T k).map
        ((operationStageTransitionIso l Ω X E L h).hom.app W) ≫
      (operationStageTransitionIso l Ω X L M k).hom.app
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.transition l Ω X E L h).obj W) ≫
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.associator l Ω X E L M h k).hom.app W =
    ((stageSystem l Ω X).assoc h k).hom.app W ≫
      (operationStageTransitionIso l Ω X E M (h.trans k)).hom.app W
